title: Reinforced Chisel
body:
"A powerful blacksteel Chisel, reinforced with Adurite found deep below the magma caves."



Description

The Reinforced Chisel, available exclusively at The Oak Depot, commands a price tag of $12,000 . Renowned as one of the best Chisels in the game a player can purchase,

Chisels are tools used to slice refined and forged ores into pieces and shave rocks to fit into processors. Do note, that shaving will reduce yield of the ore/rock, so it's advised to save them to be processed in a bigger machine later

Appearance

Refined from the finest materials, the Reinforced Chisel stands tall, crafted from blacksteel (a material yet to grace the realms of our game) and Adurite..

Trivia

- The Reinforced Chisel, alongside its companions in the reinforced tool set, was introduced as part of the highly anticipated Progression Update.

- When introduced its original price was a whopping $266,000 (Inflation much?)
